file_description: Gas Field Production - Monthly field-level gas production data
data_format: LONG format - multiple rows per field-month, one per concept

concept_descriptions.high_pressure_gas_mm3: High-pressure gas production - wellhead pressure >1000 psi (7 MPa). Requires minimal processing, can flow directly to pipeline. Highest quality, lowest cost.
concept_descriptions.medium_pressure_gas_mm3: Medium-pressure gas production - wellhead pressure 500-1000 psi (3.5-7 MPa). Requires moderate compression and processing before pipeline delivery.
concept_descriptions.low_pressure_gas_mm3: Low-pressure gas production - wellhead pressure <500 psi (3.5 MPa). Requires significant compression, often from mature/depleted reservoirs. Higher operating costs.
concept_descriptions.unconventional_gas_mm3: Unconventional gas production - from shale gas, tight gas, or coalbed methane. Requires hydraulic fracturing and horizontal drilling. Typically lower reservoir pressure.
concept_descriptions.gas_reinjection_formation_mm3: Gas reinjected into producing formation for pressure maintenance (gas cycling) or enhanced oil recovery (gas cap injection). Not sold as product.
concept_descriptions.gas_injection_storage_mm3: Gas injected into underground storage formations (typically depleted reservoirs or aquifers) for seasonal storage. Retrieved during high-demand periods.
concept_descriptions.gas_extraction_storage_mm3: Gas extracted from underground storage during high-demand periods (winter heating season). Previously injected gas now being withdrawn.
concept_descriptions.gas_heating_value_kcal_per_m3: Calorific content of gas in kilocalories per cubic meter. Typical range: 8,000-10,000 kcal/m3 (320-400 BTU/scf). Higher heating value = higher sales price.

unit_notes.mm3: Million cubic meters (Mm3) = 10^6 m3 - Argentina standard for gas volumes
unit_notes.kcal_per_m3: Kilocalories per cubic meter - heating value/energy content
unit_notes.conversion_to_opgee: Gas: Mm3 to m3 multiply by 1,000,000
unit_notes.pressure_categories: High >1000 psi, Medium 500-1000 psi, Low <500 psi

technical_notes.pressure_classification: Gas pressure categories reflect wellhead flowing pressure and indicate reservoir maturity, processing requirements, and operating costs
technical_notes.unconventional_identification: Unconventional gas requires hydraulic fracturing and is typically from shale (Vaca Muerta), tight sands, or coal seams
technical_notes.reinjection_purposes: Gas reinjection used for: (1) pressure maintenance, (2) gas cycling in condensate reservoirs, (3) gas cap injection for oil recovery, (4) CO2 substitute in EOR
